title: Ms. Bobbie The Art Pixie comes together with Chance Burlock to release a must-hear sound titled "Superstar"
htmlContent:
Canadian music star Ms. Bobbie The Art Pixie is a multi-talented transgender recording artist and producer who has climbed the steepest of steps to where she is now. The talented artist does not disappoint in releasing her recent song "Superstar."

 Ms. Bobbie The Art Pixie came together with Chance Burlock to release a must-hear sound titled "Superstar." This is the first single from the Transgender producer Ms. Bobbie The Art Pixie. It is packed with Rnb sound inspired by Motown. This song has been mixed with the modern ear in mind to give the audience what they need to the extent that they keep coming back for more.
